AssayDetails: Buffer scrub samples from multiple body sites of 15 individuals to examine differential microbiome and skin lipid profiles across body sites.
objectives: Skin surface microbes are important in the production of glycerol and free fatty acids (FFAs) by hydrolysis of long chain triglycerides.  This study is designed to provide biological samples (sebum / skin surface lipids and buffer wash samples) from five collections sites (scalp, forehead, volar forearm, back of hand and lower outer leg) from which the role of the skin microbiome and bacterial diversity has on the levels and composition of skin surface triglycerides, glycerol production and FFAs, can be investigated.  1.     Collection of skin surface lipid samples from the scalp, forehead, volar forearm, back of hand and lower outer leg of qualifying participants.    2.     Collection of buffer wash samples scalp, forehead, volar forearm, back of hand and lower outer leg of qualifying participants.
